proportions._how: Measured on the rigged model in its rest pose. head_frac = (top of mesh - head bone) / height. arm_frac = (upperarm + lowerarm bone length) / height. leg_frac = (thigh + calf bone length) / height.

palette._how: Arthur's approved colours as they read in the standard review lighting (not raw texture values). New characters should sit in the same warm, earthy family; hero accents may be stronger.

base_colour_texture._how: Checked on the base-colour texture, with pixels outside UV islands (alpha 0 or pure flat fill) ignored.
base_colour_texture._detail_noise: Mean absolute difference between the texture and a 3-pixel blur of itself (0-1), measured at 512 px. Calibrated 27 Nov on Henry: Arthur's painted T_Arthur_D_v2 = 0.013, photo-like test textures = 0.066-0.104.
base_colour_texture._calibration: Arthur (approved look): saturation 0.71, near-black 0.01%, near-white 0.12%, noise 0.013. Eye textures are exempt from the dark/bright/colour checks (pupils and whites).

checklist: Mouth closed or small; no teeth or inner mouth showing through the lips
Eye shine is one small painted highlight per eye, same side on both eyes, no glossy 'wet' reflection
Eye whites clean: no skin or brown colour bleeding into them
Both eyes the same size and height (within 5%)
Brows readable from the gameplay camera

review.lights: key 3.0 W/m2 sun from front-left above, fill 1.0 from front-right, rim 1.5 from behind; AgX; Eevee or Cycles 32 samples

generation.prompt_template: {subject}, stylised 3D game character for a family action-adventure, storybook proportions (slightly large head, about 6 to 7 heads tall), soft hand-painted textures, warm earthy palette with one clear accent colour, clean readable silhouette, matte materials, small closed mouth, simple painted eyes with one small highlight, full body, A-pose, arms 30 degrees from body, feet pointing straight forward, plain neutral background, front view
generation.avoid: open mouth, visible teeth, glossy or wet eyes, photo-realistic skin, pores, heavy wrinkles, neon colours, glowing parts, armour spikes, busy noisy textures, T-pose, crossed arms, holding props, copying any existing game or film character
reference_images: the character's own approved concept sheet
generation.settings: same generator, same version and same texture settings for every character; record them in the character entry
